"5b10f18d-fff7-5deb-ab4b-e20e51b8a320" :question/problem "Find the **exact** value of $\cos\left(\frac{5\pi}{12}\right)$.

$$"] [:db/add "5b10f18d-fff7-5deb-ab4b-e20e51b8a320" :question/worked-solution "Recall the sum formula for cosine:

$$
\begin{aligned}
&=\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\cdot \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}-\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\cdot \frac{1}{2} \\
&=\frac{\sqrt{6}}{4}-\frac{\sqrt{2}}{4} \\

$\cos\left(\frac{17\pi}{12}\right)=$ {{field-1}}"] [:db/add "a3594bde-81e0-5a40-85cd-984ec5434e25" :question/worked-solution "Recall the sum formula for cosine:

$$
\cos(x+y)=\cos x\cos y-\sin x\sin y.
$$

Apply it to the decomposition:

$$
\cos\left(\frac{17\pi}{12}\right)=\cos\left(\frac{3\pi}{4}+\frac{2\pi}{3}\right).
$$

$$
\cos\left(\frac{3\pi}{4}\right)\cos\left(\frac{2\pi}{3}\right)-\sin\left(\frac{3\pi}{4}\right)\sin\left(\frac{2\pi}{3}\right)
$$

Substitute the signed special-angle values and combine:

$$
\begin{aligned}
&=\left(- \frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\right)\cdot \left(- \frac{1}{2}\right)-\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\cdot \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} \\
&=\frac{\sqrt{2}}{4}-\frac{\sqrt{6}}{4} \\

$$"] [:db/add "4fc9ef0c-fb5d-5d39-bbec-ab1af2cf98bc" :question/worked-solution "Recall the sum formula for cosine:
